FINAL DIRECTION · GLASSBLOOM + GOLD

Your HUD, final layout

Glassbloom is the base: frosted violet glass, a floating dock, sparkle. From Golden Hoard I kept the slamming RUN! warning and the reward strip reveal. On top of that I added a vertical altitude rail, a three-tier banner system and a Camera Shake setting. The first two screens animate; press Replay on the reveal. Not built yet.

1 · The chase

A guardian wakes: the alert chip pulses, edges glow pink-red, then RUN! slams in with a shockwave ring, shakes, and fades. The sprint orb pulses until you press it. The dock stays reachable, the carry chip shows distance to the safe gate.

2 · The reveal strip

Sanctuary hatch, after the creature is secured. A strip of cards scrolls under a fixed gold selector and slows to a stop. On landing: ring burst, shards, rarity word slams in, the name follows, the chance is shown, and Collect appears after a short beat so the moment can't be skipped by accident. The strip never changes the outcome; it only shows what the server already decided.

3 · Collection, shop and settings

Same glass language everywhere: a left nav, rounded rows, one glowing active element. The shop's hero card is the only holographic surface, so the starter pack is the first thing your eye lands on.

4 · Three banner tiers

The overhaul plan needed these defined. More shine means rarer or bigger. Nothing ever covers the middle of the screen during play except tier 3, which only happens in the safe sanctuary.
